name: Komorebi no Namikimichi
source:
You play as Kouichi, who lost his wife years ago. The game places you in a love story involving six girls.

[taken from [url=http://uk.ps2.gamespy.com/playstation-2/komorebi-no-namikimichi/]GameSpy[/url]]
translation:
玩家将扮演数年前失去妻子的浩一。游戏讲述他与六名女孩之间的恋爱故事。

[摘自[url=http://uk.ps2.gamespy.com/playstation-2/komorebi-no-namikimichi/]GameSpy[/url]]
